item.title: University Food Court adds credit card fee
item.description: Students dining in the University Food Court will now find a 50 cent convenience fee added to their total if they pay with a credit card. Eastern’s merchant services provider charges a processing fee for payments made using credit cards. This convenience fee was previously paid for by the food court, according to Chris Coffey, the associate director of housing and dining for Panther Dining...

item.description: EIU women’s basketball hasn’t had the success this season the team had hoped for, a major factor being the team’s health. item.title: Cellist Joshua Romans touches on long COVID-19 struggles in ‘Immunity’
item.description: The Doudna Fine Arts Center hosted guest cellist Joshua Roman’s “Immunity” program on Saturday in the recital hall. Roman suffers from long-term COVID-19, causing him to experience several complications every day. Roman is no longer able to drive, both because of his treatment and because his body will at times shut down completely, rendering him unable to breathe or move, he said on stage. item.description: With half of the Ohio Valley Conference season done, let’s check in with the EIU men’s basketball team. item.title: EIU president issues hiring freeze at spring update to help balance budget
item.description: Eastern Illinois University President Jay Gatrell issued a hiring freeze across campus effective immediately at his spring update Tuesday morning in the Doudna Fine Arts Center Recital Hall. The hiring freeze is one of the plans aimed at balancing Eastern’s budget that Gatrell discussed during the update. He said that he thinks balancing the budget will take two years to accomplish. item.title: SGA passes RSO funding program, calls for mandatory ALICE training
item.description: The EIU Student Senate approved the creation of a Registered Student Organization grant funding program at its meeting on Wednesday. item.description: UT Martin went on a 14-2 run and outscored EIU women’s basketball 21-11 in the third quarter to pull away for a 62-46 win on Thursday at Groniger Arena.
